Entries.Title: Ceylan
Entries.Description: Ceylan is a young, innocent, and loving mother who dreams of overcoming the hardships fate has placed before her, hand in hand with her son, Yusuf. While enduring the cruelty of her abusive husband, Necmi—whom she was forced to marry—she works, studies, and secretly saves money, hoping to build a new life with her son. But a ruthless scheme by Necmi pushes Ceylan to the brink of losing the only thing that keeps her going—her son, Yusuf. Determined to save her child and chase her dreams, Ceylan steps into the dangerous world of Bekri, a powerful underground mafia boss. There, she crosses paths with Ferhat, a man with a secret mission of his own.

Episodes.Title: Episode 1
Episodes.Description: Ceylan is a young, innocent, and loving mother who dreams of overcoming the hardships fate has placed before her, hand in hand with her son, Yusuf. While enduring the cruelty of her abusive husband, Necmi—whom she was forced to marry—she works, studies, and secretly saves money, hoping to build a new life with her son. But a ruthless scheme by Necmi pushes Ceylan to the brink of losing the only thing that keeps her going—her son, Yusuf. Determined to save her child and chase her dreams, Ceylan steps into the dangerous world of Bekri, a powerful underground mafia boss. There, she crosses paths with Ferhat, a man with a secret mission of his own.

Episodes.Title: Episode 2
Episodes.Description: Ceylan swears to find those who stole the kidney of her only son Yusuf, who is fighting for his life in the hospital, and to make him pay the price. Fate has given her son to her, but the fire of revenge has already fallen into her heart. With Necmi's mind games and surprises, Ceylan is convinced that Ferhat, who saved her son, is guilty and decides to confront Ferhat for revenge.

Episodes.Title: Episode 3
Episodes.Description: Just as Ceylan is reunited with her son, she faces the bitter truth. Ceylan needs to find money for Yusuf to return to his old life. Ceylan starts to look for a possibility in the impossibility, but there is no solution. Bekri, who comes close to death in a conspiracy set up by his enemy, makes an offer that will change Ceylan's whole life. Ceylan is on the verge of sacrificing her present for the future she dreams of with her son; she is about to step into a dark world from which there is no turning back. As fate weaves its web, will Ferhat be able to protect Ceylan in this dangerous world he has never known? How far will Ceylan go to save her son; will she be able to find a way out for the sake of the dreams she has barely kept alive in the darkness?

Episodes.Title: Episode 4
Episodes.Description: Ceylan, who accepts Bekri's illegal job offer in order to cover Yusuf's treatment expenses, is determined. She risks everything for her son to regain his health. Despite all Ferhat's efforts, Ceylan does not give up; she cannot give up. Knowing the end, she steps into this dark world, hoping to leave behind the pain she has experienced and build a brand-new life with her son. On his first mission, he faces great danger and comes close to death. Gaining Bekri Vezirli's trust will not be as easy as she thinks. How will Ceylan cope with the darkness of this dangerous world she has never known? How will Ceylan's courage, who sacrifices herself for her son, affect Ferhat?

Episodes.Title: Episode 5
Episodes.Description: After passing Bekri’s ruthless loyalty test, Ceylan notices a suspicious detail about Bekri’s associates during her first mission. Though the dangers of her new job make her want to turn back while she still can, it's already too late. The dark world she entered to save Yusuf draws her in deeper with every step. Losing patience, Ferhat secretly works against Bekri—no matter the cost—to uncover the truth. As Yusuf is discharged from the hospital, Ceylan and Ferhat grow closer despite all the odds stacked against them. Meanwhile, Necmi, who narrowly escaped death, picks up right where he left off—making Ceylan’s life a living hell. He poses even greater threats and tests concerning her son and their future. Can Ceylan find a way out while fighting to survive on every front? And can Ferhat resist the feelings he harbors for Ceylan and her son while haunted by the ghosts of his past?

Episodes.Title: Episode 6
Episodes.Description: Returning home, Yusuf confronts the childhood that was stolen from him, while Ceylan, surrounded by both her old life and the dark world she is involved in, tries to escape by taking her son and leaving everything and everyone behind. The more she struggles, the deeper she seems to sink. Ferhat tries to lighten her burden with the closeness he feels a little more deeply every moment, to make her believe that another life is possible, but in vain! He cannot break down the walls of Ceylan who closes her doors to love with the wounds of the past. When she learns about Necmi's illegal gold business, Ceylan finds herself in the middle of a new fire. Necmi is ready to make Ceylan and Yusuf's lives a living hell for the sake of money, without blinking an eye if necessary.

Episodes.Title: Cure Idol Debuts!
Episodes.Description: Uta Sakura lives in Hanamichi Town. One day while on a walk, she meets a fairy named Purirun. Purirun has come in search of Kirakiland’s savior called Idol Precure.

Episodes.Title: Am I Going Viral?

Episodes.Title: Have Courage! Cure Wink Debuts!
Episodes.Description: Nana, who is feeling down about a mistake she made during her piano competition, is invited to Uta’s family’s home, Café Glitter. Uta and Uta’s little sister Hamori cheer her up, and she is ready to do her best at the school welcome event…

Episodes.Title: The Legendary Idol?! Kaito Hibiki
Episodes.Description: Just like it did with Cure Idol, the word is spreading about Cure Wink. Meanwhile, another popular “legendary idol” Kaito Hibiki drops by Cafe Glitter.

Episodes.Title: We Got a Manager!
Episodes.Description: A man named Tanaka appears before Uta and Nana and says he knows they're Idol Precures. Meanwhile, a message arrives that says, “I want to hire the Pretty Cures.”

Episodes.Title: My Heart's Going Kyun-Kyun?!
Episodes.Description: Uta and Nana get to know Kokoro Shigure, president of the Cure Idol and Cure Wink Research Club. Purirun wants to become friends with Kokoro and follows her after school.

Episodes.Title: Dancing Heart! Cure Kyun-Kyun's Debut!
Episodes.Description: Kokoro is shocked to see Cure Idol and Cure Wink battle the Makkuranda, and runs away, saying “I can’t do that!” She tries to forget about the Idol Precures that she loves by putting away all her merchandise and dancing her troubles away, but…

Episodes.Title: Sleepover! Idol Precure Study Session!
Episodes.Description: Kokoro says she wants to study Cure Idol and Cure Wink, so they decide to have a sleepover at Uta’s house.

Episodes.Title: The Seven Wonders of Nana!
Episodes.Description: On their way home from school, Nana suddenly begins acting strangely. When she continues to say and do strange things, Uta and Kokoro start to count the “Seven Wonders of Nana.”

Episodes.Title: CD Debut! Idol Precure!
Episodes.Description: The Idol Precure songs are being made into a CD, so Cure Idol and the others start recording. But Cure Kyun-Kyun is so nervous that she can’t sing well.

Episodes.Title: Trio Dreams
Episodes.Description: Inspired by the school broadcast, Uta and the others begin to think about their dreams for the future. To help Uta, who is having trouble deciding, Nana and Kokoro begin “Uta’s Dream Search Project.”

Episodes.Title: Purirun's fan, Meroron is here!
Episodes.Description: A new arrival to Hanamichi Town from Kirakiland is discovered. Purirun says it’s Meroron, and Uta and her friends go searching for them.

Episodes.Title: Go! Go! Kirakilight!
Episodes.Description: Uta and her friends form a girls volleyball team for the school ball-game tournament. On her team is Wakaba, a member of the official school team. She’s in love with Shota, another volleyball player, and declares that she’ll tell him her feelings if they win.

Episodes.Title: Dear Mom, a Message from Kokoro
Episodes.Description: Kokoro’s mother has to work despite it being the weekend, and Kokoro sees her off. Kokoro buys her a carnation for Mother’s Day and has trouble coming up with a good message for the card, so she drops by Cafe Glitter to get some advice.

Episodes.Title: Operation Make Sissy Fall In Love
Episodes.Description: Meroron is jealous of Purirun’s relationship with Uta, so Uta and the others, who also want to be closer with Meroron, encourage Purirun to spend more time with Meroron. Purirun invites Meroron to dress in matching outfits and go on a date.

Episodes.Title: Full Bloom! Intensive Practice! Hanamichi Town Festival!
Episodes.Description: Idol Precure is invited to appear at the Hanamichi Town Festival. Uta and the others want to make the event a success, so they ask Tanaka to help them make an intensive practice regimen.

Episodes.Title: Purirun's Decision! Let's Go to Kirakiland!
Episodes.Description: Purirun desperately wants to help Uta and decides to go to Kirakiland with Meroron. Meanwhile, Uta and the others are preparing to go on stage at the Hanamichi Town Festival.

Episodes.Title: Who Are You? Zukyoon Through My Heart!
Episodes.Description: A mysterious duo has suddenly appeared: Cure Zukyoon and Cure Kiss. Uta wakes up in the middle of a dream about Cure Zukyoon, and even at school her head is full of Cure Zukyoon all day. Kokoro sees this and determines that Uta has become a fan of Cure Zukyoon.

Episodes.Title: The Pair's Vow! Cure Zukyoon and Cure Kiss Debut!
Episodes.Description: Cure Idol and her friends chase after Cure Zukyoon and Cure Kiss but lose sight of them. Sometime later, a magazine reporter who wants to learn the truth about the duo appears, and Uta and the others offer to help.

Episodes.Title: Puri! A Picnic to Find Memories!
Episodes.Description: Uta and the others learn that Purirun gave up all their memories of them to become a Precure. Uta and the others invite the fairies on a picnic to try to recover Purirun's memories.

Episodes.Title: Super-Duper! A Miracle in Unison!

Episodes.Title: How to Take Revenge

Episodes.Title: How to Confront
Episodes.Description: Hiro and Kiryu must face off in a test to represent their company. Confident at first, Hiro starts to feel the pressure after seeing Kiryu’s detailed hair designs. Then, Kiryu shows up at Hiro’s place unannounced...

Episodes.Title: How to Give a Gift
Episodes.Description: After the contest, Hiro agrees to reward Natsuo with a date. Expecting something outrageous, he's surprised by a simple walk. But when Natsuo gets too close and Hiro pushes him away, the date takes an unexpected turn—leaving Hiro with a sudden realization.

Episodes.Title: How to Deal with a Rival in Love
Episodes.Description: On his birthday, Hiro grants Natsuki’s wish for a kiss. The next day, he feels uneasy when Oribe, Natsuki’s former crush, asks to be alone with him. The tension grows when Natsuki calls Oribe “fragile, unlike Hiro.”

Episodes.Title: How to Hide an Injury
Episodes.Description: Hiro learns he was Natsuo’s first love and can’t stop thinking about it. Distracted, he gets hurt, and Natsuo shows up to care for him. Living under the same roof brings them closer—until news from the hospital changes everything.

Episodes.Title: How to Face the Past
Episodes.Description: Hiro gives Natsuo a spare key, but a reunion invite stirs painful memories. Refusing to go, Hiro leaves for work—until Natsuo, staying behind, makes a discovery that could change everything.

Episodes.Title: The Proper Way to Write Love
Episodes.Description: Hiro reveals to Natsuo that he had been dating him as part of a high school revenge plan, leaving Natsuo shocked. While apart, Hiro takes on cutting popular influencer RaMu’s hair—but an accident news from Aoi changes everything…

Entries.Title: Shifting Gears

Episodes.Title: Accommodations
Episodes.Description: Matt joins Riley at Carter's high school open house, where he's unsettled to learn about the "accommodations" made for his grandson's anxiety. Meanwhile, Riley reconnects with Caitlin, a former classmate, and sets her up with Gabriel.

Episodes.Description: Riley, desperate for work, reluctantly takes a job at Matt's shop; Gabriel and Stitch secretly stray from Matt's vision on a high-stakes restomod project.

Episodes.Title: Grief

Episodes.Title: Jimmy
Episodes.Description: Riley’s estranged husband, Jimmy, shows up to win her back, much to Matt’s dismay. While Matt struggles to get through to him, Riley finds support in an unexpected place.

Episodes.Title: Valentine's
Episodes.Description: A Valentine's Day visit to his late wife's grave sparks an unexpected connection for Matt in an unlikely place; Riley is thrust into the spotlight for a promotional video at the dance studio.

Episodes.Title: Picnic
Episodes.Description: The feud between Parker Customs and Premiere Dance Lab heats up when Matt confronts the owner over a picnic table placed in the shared alleyway; Carter's need for "me time" sparks a conversation with Matt.

Episodes.Title: Career
Episodes.Description: Georgia invites Matt and Riley to speak at her school's Career Day, where playful competition turns tense when Riley learns Georgia is ashamed of her job; Gabriel mentors Carter's car project until a more urgent piece of business arises.

Episodes.Title: Gummies
Episodes.Description: Riley is horrified when she finds weed gummies in Carter’s pocket, prompting surprising advice from Matt. Meanwhile, Eve inadvertently lands Gabriel and Stitch in hot water after asking them to donate to a charity auction.

Episodes.Title: Kiss
Episodes.Description: Riley is torn between her past and her future.

However, his life is soon thrown in peril as he finds himself surrounded by monsters.

Episodes.Description: Kenichi is steadily increasing his sales when Myaley and other beastfolk are lured into him by the smell of spices. He refuses to sell spices to them so he can stay off the radar of the spice syndicates, but he gives into pressure from the beastfolk and offers an alternative. Primula, the first daughter of the Mallow Trading Company appears before Kenichi.

Episodes.Title: Welcome to the murderous party File 1
Episodes.Description: Wealthy heiress Reiko Hosho leads a double life as a novice detective. One day, an incident erupts at a birthday party she attends with friends from her college days. The victim is one of her old classmates, and Reiko's friends are labeled as suspects for matching the attacker's description. Stirring in confusion with only 20 minutes to solve the case, a man suddenly appears to reveal the culprit.

Episodes.Title: Welcome to the murderous party File 2 / Here's a message from the dead File 1
Episodes.Description: Mystery butler Kageyama concocts a peculiar plan to catch the criminal lurking in a luxury hotel, after which Reiko and her friends realize the hidden complexity of their own emotions. Reiko then tackles the murder case of a real estate tycoon. Each of the victim's relatives harbor suspicious motives to kill, but a single photograph proves essential in accelerating this perplexing investigation.

Episodes.Title: Here's a message from the dead File 2
Episodes.Description: While investigating the murder of a real estate tycoon, Reiko examines an erased dying message, a bloody trophy, and a cord yanked from the curtains. Without proof, however, she reaches a dead end...until savage butler Kageyama emerges to solve the mystery. Reiko and Kyoichiro think outside the box to trap the murderer, peek inside the victim's mindset, and end a chain of events fueled by revenge.

Episodes.Title: Please be aware of two-timing affairs File 1
Episodes.Description: With Kageyama as her chauffeur, Reiko and her friends visit a crowded summer festival, where a cracked smartphone is discovered. Its owner was poisoned in his apartment, and he died wearing nothing but briefs. Three women the victim dated simultaneously on a matching app fail to match the height of a suspect seen exiting his residence, which leaves Reiko puzzled at the true culprit's identity.

Episodes.Title: Please be aware of two-timing affairs File 2 / The person who dropped it is a VTuber File 1
Episodes.Description: Women of differing heights are spotted at the crime scene. Kageyama suspects that elevator shoes disguised the murderer's appearance. After learning that the victim had scammed several women via dating apps, Reiko inches closer to the truth. Later, a delivery man is found dead with an item belonging to his favorite VTuber, and it's discovered that the two even frequented the same hospital.

Episodes.Title: The person who dropped it is a VTuber File 2
Episodes.Description: After a delivery man falls to his death, Reiko and Kyoichiro investigate his connection to popular VTuber "Kuru Kuru-Chan," who is blamed for the murder by fans online. Kageyama assists in analyzing a mystery figure planting bugs, untouched food deliveries, and hints to the true culprit left at the crime scene. The victim leaves a note reading, "I've had enough of this world," but in what context?

Episodes.Title: There is no such thing as a completely locked room File 1
Episodes.Description: A famous painter is stabbed in his own studio, pointing to his masterpiece wall painting "Sleeping Beauty" just before dying. Suspects include his art-jacking son, his second wife, and an art magazine writer with whom he supposedly had an affair. Reiko and Kyoichiro investigate how the killer escaped a locked studio, eventually learning of the victim's connection to a certain "Appraisal Queen."

Episodes.Title: There is no such thing as a completely locked room File 2 / Please don't drown in this river File 1
Episodes.Description: Kageyama locates a secret passageway to solve the locked-room murder mystery. Upon encountering a deranged woman wielding a knife, Reiko is left with nowhere to escape. On the next case, a white-suited journalist's body is discovered by the river. Despite being dry, his cause of death is drowning. With debts to pay, he had targeted a well-known "Shaketopia" actress whom Reiko adored as a child.

Episodes.Title: Please don't drown in this river File 2
Episodes.Description: Journalist Ryota Ishiguro's body is found on the riverbank, but although the cause of his death is drowning, the body is dry. Reiko's investigations lead her to Shiho and Satoshi Kambara, a loving couple from whom Ishiguro had been demanding money, but they claim to have an alibi. The discovery of a silver spoon with the engraving "Shiho to Leo" takes the case in an unexpected direction.

Episodes.Title: Murder lies in a beautiful rose
Episodes.Description: A woman's body is found in a bed of blooming roses at the prestigious Fujikura residence. The victim is Toshio Fujikura's fiancée, and the suspects include members of the family. Reiko, who happens to be their neighbor, is fearful that her identity will be exposed. As the investigation continues, they discover that the victim's pet cat is missing, which may be a key to solving the case.

Episodes.Title: The bride is behind locked doors
Episodes.Description: Reiko attends the wedding of Sawamura Yuri, who she cherishes like a younger sister. The groom is Hosoyama, a consultant for a family friend. When Yuri is attacked and gravely injured in her room during the party, Reiko risks her identity being revealed to help solve the case. But when the crime scene is found to be a perfect locked room, Reiko is suspected of being an accomplice.

Episodes.Title: What is it that you have lost?
Episodes.Description: Trouble strikes the Sawamura family again when Miyuki Sawamura is kidnapped and a ransom of 50 million yen is demanded. With no other suspects, Reiko sets her sights on Hosoyama. She takes Kageyama to the ransom handover disguised as a couple. Despite the perpetrator's traps, they inch closer to the truth, and find that the case is connected to an incident that occurred three years prior.

Entries.Title: Umamusume: Cinderella Gray
Entries.Description: Nestled in the sleepy countryside lies Kasamatsu Tracen Academy. Jo Kitahara, a trainer, can't help but bemoan the state of regional races compared to the star-studded national scene. But one day, as he passively watches the newest batch of racers practice, he spots an ashen-haired Umamusume. After seeing her stunning racing form, Jo Kitahara is convinced—at long last, he's found a star.

Episodes.Title: I'm Here
Episodes.Description: Nestled in the sleepy countryside lies Kasamatsu Tracen Academy. Jo Kitahara, a trainer, can't help but bemoan the state of regional races compared to the star-studded national scene. But one day, as he passively watches the newest batch of racers practice, he spots an ashen-haired Umamusume. After seeing her stunning racing form, Jo Kitahara is convinced—at long last, he's found a star.

Episodes.Title: Let Me Race
Episodes.Description: Oguri Cap and Belno Light are officially scouted by Jo Kitahara. Seeing as a racer needs to belong to a team in order to race, Oguri Cap accepts and begins training for her debut race. When the day arrives, she finds the student hailed as their generation's ace—Fujimasa March—waiting for her...

Episodes.Title: View from the Top
Episodes.Description: Up until now, Oguri Cap has simply run because she can, but after her heated race with Fujimasa March, her heart wells with a new, bitter emotion. As Oguri Cap and her team ensure she's properly prepared for her next race, another opponent shows her face: Norn Ace. Annoyed by Oguri Cap, Norn Ace's friends propose a certain "strategy" to her...

Episodes.Title: The Junior Crown
Episodes.Description: The day of the Junior Crown is here, and Oguri Cap and Fujimasa March make good on the promise they made at Mt. Kinka to enter. While Oguri Cap had no answer when Fujimasa March asked her for her goal back then, her aspirations will surely take shape during this race with her rival.

Episodes.Title: What's Best for Her
Episodes.Description: Oguri Cap and the rest of her team make their way to Chukyo Racecourse for the Chukyo Hai, but Kitahara can't shake Musaka's ominous words from his mind. Brows furrowed, he heads for the stands, only to discover Symboli Rudolf and Maruzensky have come to observe the race.

Episodes.Title: The Beast
Episodes.Description: After Symboli Rudolf offers his trainee a place in the Twinkle Series, Kitahara approaches a reluctant Oguri Cap with a wager—if she wins the Gold Junior, she'll transfer to the nationals; otherwise, they'll aim for the Tokai Derby. As she heads into the race, Oguri Cap remains conflicted. She wants to give her all in her long-awaited battle against March, but...

Episodes.Title: Tracen Academy
Episodes.Description: Musaka gives Tracen Academy's two newest students—Oguri Cap and Belno Light—a tour of the expansive campus. Afterwards, Oguri Cap comes face to face with her new classmates—and potential rivals. As class begins, the teacher explains the goal of many of her contemporaries, the G1 Classic Triple Crown. There's just one problem...

Episodes.Title: The Right Stuff
Episodes.Description: Oguri Cap's transfer from Kasamatsu has unfortunately overlapped with the registration deadline for the Classic races. Eager to show Symboli Rudolf she has what it takes to take on these races, she sets her sights on the G3 Pegasus Stakes. But standing in her way is a racer with four consecutive wins under her belt...

Episodes.Title: The Japanese Derby
Episodes.Description: Symboli Rudolf witnesses Oguri Cap's might firsthand—the no-name racer from the boonies wipes the floor with even the strong national racers. In her, Symboli Rudolf sees a star capable of setting the Twinkle Series alight. But should she use her authority to advocate for a miracle at the Japan Derby, or should she remain loyal to the rules?

Episodes.Title: The Peak
Episodes.Description: Ultimately, Oguri Cap is unable to enter the Japanese Derby, which means she needs a new racing goal. Hoping to inspire Oguri Cap, Musaka takes her and Belno Light to see the Takarazuka Kinen, a Grand Prix race where the lineup is decided by a fan poll. There, Oguri Cap witnesses the racer currently dominating the Twinkle Series.

Episodes.Title: The Star of Kasamatsu
Episodes.Description: Musaka declares that if Oguri Cap wants to take on Tamamo Cross in the fall Tenno Sho, she has to win the Mainichi Okan. A task easier said than done, as Oguri Cap's winning streak means all her rivals' eyes are on her. This year's Mainichi Okan is shaping up to be a ten-versus-one race...

Episodes.Title: The Fall Tenno Sho
Episodes.Description: At last, the day of the fall Tenno Sho arrives, and with it, the first clash between the two ashen-haired Umamusume, Tamamo Cross and Oguri Cap. Hoping to surpass the top racer and become the best in all of Japan, Oguri Cap steps onto the turf. Although Tamamo Cross holds a similar dream, there's a special someone in her heart as she enters the course.

Episodes.Title: Japan's Best
Episodes.Description: The crowd is on the edge of their seats as the racers enter the homestretch of the fall Tenno Sho. With 400 meters remaining, each runner musters the last of their strength. With Oguri Cap right on her tail, Tamamo Cross begins to feel the pressure. As exhaustion creeps in, her past flashes before her eyes. Her loved ones in her heart, Tamamo Cross breaks past her limits and enters a zone beyond her rivals...

Episodes.Title: The Flavor of a Sun-Kissed Gyaru's Lips
Episodes.Description: On a midsummer's day, Tsuyoshi heads to the convenience store to get chuhai, and reunites with Ai Natsuno, his junior from high school. Ai is now married, with a huge makeover as a sun-kissed gyaru, but acts like a spoiled child around Tsuyoshi, just like she used to.

Episodes.Title: The Flavor of a Married Club Senpai's Lips
Episodes.Description: Tsuyoshi starts an online drinking session with his two guy friends, and the college idol senpai, Miki Kanzaki. As Miki gets drunk from canned chuhai and exposes herself on screen, Tsuyoshi and the gang can't take their eyes off her.

Episodes.Title: The Flavor of My Russian Friend's Sister's Lips
Episodes.Description: Tsuyoshi goes round Joseph's house and meets his older sister and married Russian beauty, Anastasia. The three have canned chuhai, but Anastasia gets dead drunk and mistakes Tsuyoshi for her younger brother. He ends up taking care of her, but...

Episodes.Title: The Flavor of a Mysterious, Tanuki-Faced Married Woman's Lips
Episodes.Description: One night when Tsuyoshi was wandering around town with canned chuhai in his hand, he meets a wild tanuki, and gets led to a big mansion. There he meets a tanuki-faced beauty, Tamami Miyazawa, who gives him a warm reception, but for a certain reason...

Episodes.Title: The Flavor of a Baby-Faced, Cheeky Married Woman's Lips
Episodes.Description: By chance, Tsuyoshi ends up having a one-night stand with Nozomi Kuji, a married woman who looks too young for her age. Since then, they've become canned chuhai drinking buddies. In the midst of this, Nozomi vents out her frustration about her busty-loving hubby, and Tsuyoshi gets lectured on the appeal of small breasts...

Episodes.Title: The Flavor of an Otherworldly, Married Dark Elf's Lips
Episodes.Description: Tsuyoshi enters a parallel universe and saves a dark elf beauty, Symphis with the skill he gained from the chuhai god. Tsuyoshi gradually becomes drawn to Symphis as she talks about her husband, but something doesn't add up...

Episodes.Title: The Flavor of a Quiet Former Rebel, the Barbershop Owner's Lips
Episodes.Description: As Tsuyoshi goes to his regular barbershop, the quiet forty-odd beauty owner, Sari Kirihara, announces that the shop will be closing down. Tsuyoshi ends up drinking canned chuhai at Sari's house without the presence of her husband, but realizing her secret feelings, tries to snuggle up to her...

Entries.Description: On the vast farmlands of Centvelt in the continent of Avrion, the Farmagias diligently tend to their fields. Meanwhile, Ten spends his days slacking off, focused on raising the ultimate monster. One day, shocking news arrives: The Magus Diluculum has suddenly died.

Episodes.Title: The Beginning of Chaos
Episodes.Description: On the vast farmlands of Centvelt in the continent of Avrion, the Farmagias diligently tend to their fields. Meanwhile, Ten spends his days slacking off, focused on raising the ultimate monster. One day, shocking news arrives: The Magus Diluculum has suddenly died.

Episodes.Title: Rebellion of Avrion
Episodes.Description: Airing on Friday, January 17, 2025 Ten and Leii face off against the masked warrior Zanas, who attacks an orphanage. Overwhelmed by the vast difference in their abilities as Farmagias, the two find themselves in a dire situation. However, with the timely assistance of Nares, they manage to successfully repel Zanas. After the battle, gazing upon the ruins of the burned-down orphanage, Ten and the others resolve to rebel against the new Magus, Glaza.

Episodes.Title: Reunion in Enemy Territory
Episodes.Description: To defeat Manas, Ten, Leii, and Arche infiltrate Perfectus as an elite strike team, aiming for the castle. During their mission, they reunite with their missing comrade, Emero. While Ten is overjoyed by the reunion, Emero gazes at them with a stern expression and utters a chilling remark.

Episodes.Title: Uniting Bonds
Episodes.Description: Determined to match Emero, who demonstrated mastery over controlling monster powers, Ten repeatedly attempts to "Unite" but fails no matter how hard he tries, growing increasingly frustrated. Then, Emero appears before Ten and the others once more, but this time, he shows even greater hostility toward them.

Episodes.Title: To the City of Muscles
Episodes.Description: After defeating Manas and returning to Avrion, Ten and the others let Arche rest to recover from a sudden collapse. Ten and Leii then head to their next destination, Rahatluk, on their own. Successfully infiltrating the city, they pull a cart through the streets, only to realize someone is hiding in the cargo. That person is...

Episodes.Title: Beyond the Corpses
Episodes.Description: As Ten and the others panic over Chica's disappearance, Zanas once again stands in their way. Effortlessly deflecting their attacks, Zanas reveals that Chica has been captured by the Corpus before leaving. Determined to ensure their dear comrade's safety, Ten and his group rush to Rahatluk Fortress.

Episodes.Title: In return for the Truth
Episodes.Description: After a fierce battle with the Corpus, Ten and his group emerge victorious. Returning to Avrion, they throw a party to celebrate Emero's return. While everyone enjoys the festivities, Ten, worried about Arche’s absence due to poor health, goes to visit her—only to discover that she has disappeared. Together with his comrades, Ten desperately searches for her, but...

Episodes.Title: The Chosen Ones
Episodes.Description: Receiving a report from Anzar, who has infiltrated Sonrisa and uncovered the guard placements, Nares assigns Ten and the group the mission to defeat L'Oreille. They land in Sonrisa and begin their advance, but while Anzar steps away to scout the enemy, they are ambushed by L'Oreille, Zanas, and Glaza.

Episodes.Title: The Three Angels
Episodes.Description: On the day of peace negotiations, Nares faces L'Oreille with her army on the continent of. Tension fills the air as Ten and the others quietly observe the two. Declaring no intent to attack, Nares speaks calmly, but L'Oreille, with a sinister smile, unleashes the supposedly undecipherable grand magic, "Harvest Festival.

Episodes.Title: Through the Darkness
Episodes.Description: Nares wakes up in the Magus’s castle, where she is shocked to see the Oración Seis, who were believed to be dead. To her further confusion, Lisan mocks her, and standing before her is the former Magus, Diluculum. Meanwhile, Ten and the others, assaulted by L'Oreille, are swallowed by an impenetrable darkness with no light in sight.

Episodes.Title: The Path of the Brother
Episodes.Description: Having completely lost their sense of self, the Oración Seis transform into Reapers and charge at Ten and the others with terrifying roars. Each of them faces a one-on-one battle, but Ten, confronted by Nares, hesitates to fight. Unable to summon any monsters, he desperately continues to call out to her, torn and unsure of what to do.

Episodes.Title: Dragons of Centvelt
Episodes.Description: Together with Anzar, who has regained his sense of self, Ten and the others challenge the Magus Diluculum to a final battle. However, even their strongest attacks have no effect on Diluculum. As the world gradually collapses due to the "Grand Harvest Festival," Ten and his comrades continue to struggle desperately, refusing to give up.

Episodes.Title: Episode 4
Episodes.Description: When Léo leaks word of their win, Jess scrambles to spin a cover story, but her plan sends cash flying around school and draws all the wrong attention.

Episodes.Title: Episode 5
Episodes.Description: Over champagne and salmon, the gang lives large until cryptic texts threaten to expose their schemes and Tom takes a shot at cracking a strange code.

Episodes.Title: Episode 6
Episodes.Description: David and Samia chase a suspected blackmailer through the city, while Jess fast-tracks a big first — just in case potential jail time kills the vibe.

Episodes.Title: Episode 7
Episodes.Description: The group finds a solution to end the blackmailing, but once again they need Victoire's cooperation. Léo finally admits his true feelings.

Episodes.Title: Episode 8
Episodes.Description: David's birthday bash is the teens' final shot to flip the script. As plans unfold, it becomes harder to understand who can actually be trusted.

Entries.Title: Iyanu
Entries.Description: Iyanu, aka The Chosen, triggers her Divine Powers, escapes Elu, and embarks on a journey to uncover the truth behind the evil lurking in Yorubaland.

Episodes.Title: The Chosen
Episodes.Description: Iyanu, aka The Chosen, triggers her Divine Powers, escapes Elu, and embarks on a journey to uncover the truth behind the evil lurking in Yorubaland.

Episodes.Title: The Exiles
Episodes.Description: Fleeing evil Chancellor Nuro, Iyanu meets the Corrupt Divine Beast Ekun and Biyi. As she uncovers her powers, she explores hidden Wonders beyond Elu.

Episodes.Title: The Eso of Eso
Episodes.Description: Kanfo, leader of the Eso Warriors, brings his son Toye to hunt Iyanu, while she meets Mama Sewa, a sage with secret knowledge of her past and powers.

Episodes.Title: The Arrival
Episodes.Description: As Elu's political climate worsens, Iyanu intensifies her training with Sewa while two armies converge on the Riverlands Settlement to capture her.

Episodes.Title: The People of the Deep
Episodes.Description: Iyanu, Biyi and Sewa battle the Corrupt Divine Beast Ekun and the People of the Deep, while Elu's Workers demand justice from the King and Nuro.

Episodes.Title: The Walk of Death
Episodes.Description: Iyanu, Biyi, Toye and Ekun (aka TEAM CHOSEN) cross The Rinku Plains to find The Source, key to Iyanu's powers and lifting the Curse on Yorubaland.

Episodes.Title: The Betrayal
Episodes.Description: As Elu falls into civil war, Biyi and the Oba share stories of heartbreak. Team Chosen struggles to reach The Source while Olori searches for Iyanu.

Episodes.Title: The Sacred
Episodes.Description: Team Chosen reaches The Sacred Settlement, where Iyanu must pass three Trials to prove she's The Chosen, while Nuro, now possessed, pursues them.

Episodes.Title: The Source (1)
Episodes.Description: As Cursed animals besiege Elu, Iyanu searches for The Source. Meanwhile, Biyi, Toye, Olori and Kanfo battle Nuro's forces to buy time for Iyanu.

Episodes.Title: The Source (2)
Episodes.Description: Iyanu reaches The Source and faces a devastating choice. As Elu nears destruction, her allies fight a final battle against Nuro and the Fallen One.

Episodes.Title: Iyanu: The Age of Wonders
Episodes.Description: Ages before The Chosen, Yorubaland thrives -- until the diabolical Meje appears. Warriors Dara and Ishe must stop it and prevent the Age of Darkness.

Episodes.Description: At the ripe age of 5, Liam is gifted a custom-order AI robot by his parents, and then granted full control of their fiefdom, the stellar system of Alcaeus, so they can abandon him for the capital and leave him shouldered with the family's debts.

Episodes.Title: FIRST LOVE

Episodes.Title: HERO

Episodes.Title: DESPAIR
Episodes.Description: Luke suffers more loss and falls into despair while Memmeln comes up with a certain plan with Meg and Sally.

Episodes.Title: ZENSHU
Episodes.Description: Natsuko has to draw one final thing to save the Last Town from its greatest threat.

Episodes.Title: The Vampire of the Public Bathhouse
Episodes.Description: A vampire works in a bathhouse in hopes of drinking the virgin blood of its heir Rihito, who worryingly falls in love on his first day of high school.

Episodes.Title: The Unpleasant Vampire
Episodes.Description: Ranmaru worries he has inadvertently made Aoi interested in Rihito. Rihito chats with Aoi the next day after school, but they soon get into trouble.

Episodes.Title: Franken and the Vampire
Episodes.Description: After saving Aoi, a hungry Ranmaru tries to resist the urge to feed on her. Rihito soon arrives at the scene and comes to a mistaken realization.

Episodes.Title: The Vampire's Slumber Party
Episodes.Description: Franken proclaims his admiration for Ranmaru, who tasks him with protecting Rihito. Franken tags along with them back to the Tatsuno house for dinner.

Episodes.Title: The Vampire of Fate
Episodes.Description: Rihito's teacher Sakamoto — an undercover vampire hunter of notable lineage — learns that his longtime foe Ranmaru lives with the Tatsunos.

Episodes.Title: A Vampire Put on The Spot
Episodes.Description: As Sakamoto tells Ranmaru the reason for his unexpected request, a puzzled Rihito walks in on them. Ranmaru reveals how Sakamoto's ancestor died.

Episodes.Title: The Cornered Vampire
Episodes.Description: At the Koi Bathhouse, Franken and Sakamoto attempt to bring their plan to fruition by urging Rihito to tell Aoi how he feels about her.

Episodes.Title: A Gal and the Vampire
Episodes.Description: Tough girl Kaoru is charmed by Rihito's cuteness, but when she goes to return a handkerchief he lent her, she can't seem to drop her brash attitude.

Episodes.Title: A Certain family and the Vampire
Episodes.Description: After a confrontation with Kaoru's father, Ranmaru attempts to drink Kaoru's blood. However, he's repulsed by her makeup — which gives him an idea.

Episodes.Title: Mr. Sakamoto and the Vampire
Episodes.Description: Sakamoto tells Ranmaru he was attacked by a vampire at the school. After a remedial night class, Franken and Kaoru encounter a boyish-looking vampire.

Episodes.Title: Love, the Cross, and the Vampire
Episodes.Description: Thoughts of Rihito give Ranmaru strength as he struggles against the formidable Nagayoshi. Suddenly, Kaoru appears with an improvised weapon in hand.

Episodes.Title: And Thus, A New Vampire
Episodes.Description: Ranmaru asks Rihito's father to let Nagayoshi stay in the apartment behind the bathhouse. A newly inspired Nagayoshi declares he's in love with Kaoru.

From that moment, the tide of war shifts dramatically, ultimately leading to Principality of Zeon’s victory in the One Year War. However, just before the end of the war, Gundam and Char...

Episodes.Title: Machu in Clan Battle
Episodes.Description: Amate meets a boy named Shuji, who pilots the Red Gundam. She can’t forget the sensation of the glowing universe they experienced together and suggests forming a MAV to enter the Clan Battle. Amate decides to use the entry name "MACHU."

Episodes.Title: The Witch's War
Episodes.Description: A super unicum known as the "Witch," who shot down over 100 enemies during the One Year War, enters the Clan Battle to settle an old score with the Red Gundam. Seeing this Witch, who clings to mobile suit combat even at the cost of abandoning her husband and child, Machu witnesses the depths of human obsession.

Episodes.Title: Nyaan Doesn't Know About Kira-Kira

Episodes.Title: The Plot to Assassinate Kycilia
Episodes.Description: Annqi discovers Shuji’s hideout. Information about the Red Gundam is worth more than any Clan Battle prize money. Machu finds out that Annqi schemes to sell that intel during the Clan Battle. Earth Federation forces’ intelligence agency finds out about Kycilia’s top secret information decides to…

Episodes.Title: Machu's Rebellion
Episodes.Description: Upon learning of Annqi's plan, Machu devises a plan with Nyaan to use the Clan Battle as a means to help Shuji escape. However, their opponent in the next Clan Battle turns out to be a newly built mobile armor operated by terrorists aiming to assassinate Kycilia.

Episodes.Title: Falling on the Moon
Episodes.Description: In the final stages of the One Year War, the Sodon Fleet led by Char launched to stop the Earth Federation forces' operation to drop Solomon Fortress; to protect the lunar city of Granada. Five years later in Granada. Nyaan was there with Kycilia.

Episodes.Title: The Rose of Sharon
Episodes.Description: Guided by a mysterious message, Machu escapes Sodon and descends alone to Earth in GQuuuuuuX. After crash-landing to Earth, she is rescued by a woman adored as “lady,” who is being held captive in the Kabas estate. Machu decides to escape with her and attempts to flee in the Core Fighter.

Episodes.Title: Yomagn'tho Blockade
Episodes.Description: To stop Yomagn'tho from causing destruction, Machu takes on a mission from Challia Bull to rescue the girl of rose. However, Kycilia makes her move first. Nyaan’s mobile suit, the GFreD, begins activating the Zeknova cannon. Its target: all of humanity on Earth—

Episodes.Title: Alphacide
Episodes.Description: Machu's GQuuuuuuX fights against Nyaan's GFreD as she tries to rescue the girl of rose. Eventually, guided by Shuji, Machu ventures alone into the heart of Yomagn'tho. There, she meets Char and Kycilia.

Episodes.Title: That's Why I...
Episodes.Description: This is the end game. A white mobile suit appears from the other side, attempting to kill Lalah. To Machu’s shock, the pilot of this White Devil is none other than Shuji. Determined to protect Lalah, Machu becomes a MAV with Nyaan and decides to fight Shuji.

Still trapped in the train’s bathroom, the team’s fate rests in Kanata’s hands.

Can he save the others—and maybe earn the trust of Akane, who once called him “a tempura shrimp tail”?

Entries.Description: Satsuki Amamiya, a member of the Photography Club, finds herself in a slump as her beloved club president graduates from high school. Her best friend, An Kiriyama, cheers her up, reigniting Satsuki's motivation to give the club her best again. But the 360-degree camera Satsuki bought at an online auction hasn't arrived yet! Satsuki and An pay the seller a visit.

Episodes.Title: mono Trip
Episodes.Description: Satsuki Amamiya, a member of the Photography Club, finds herself in a slump as her beloved club president graduates from high school. Her best friend, An Kiriyama, cheers her up, reigniting Satsuki's motivation to give the club her best again. But the 360-degree camera Satsuki bought at an online auction hasn't arrived yet! Satsuki and An pay the seller a visit.

Episodes.Title: Making of Some Aerial Photography! / Visiting a Classmate, 3000 Leagues - Motovlog Part 12
Episodes.Description: Satsuki and An use a makeshift drone to try some photography when they receive notice that the photography club will be dissolved due to the lack of members. Troubled by this news, they invite fellow classmate Sakurako Shikishima from the Cinema Club, which has also received a dissolution notice. Meanwhile, Haruno is stuck on her manga draft when her high school friend, Kako Komada, pays her a visit. The two hit the road for a tour.

Episodes.Title: Right Before It Becomes an Anime!! The Manga Pilgrimage Stamp Rally with a Schedule from Hell!
Episodes.Description: Haruno gets word of a manga that will be adapted into an anime. As she lives in the real-life location of that manga's story, she scouts out locations and decides to make it a focus for her manga creations. Haruno tries to carry out her plan to visit these manga pilgrimage sites on an ambitious schedule, but the other members of the Cinephoto Club can't seem to hide their unease. And so begins the hellish schedule of this location scouting tour....

Episodes.Title: A Comfy Manga Artist Goes on a Winery Tour - Motovlog Part 13 / Taking Pictures of Food and Getting Full Until We Explode
Episodes.Description: Haruno invites Satsuki and the rest to join an event where they take pictures and eat while walking. The three girls happily accept, thinking it's the perfect event for the Cinephoto Club, but they find out they'll be going around shops that serve generous portions of food to the point they'll be full! They're disappointed in the food brought to them, but this is just the beginning of their fight.

Episodes.Title: The Story of Dry-Cured Ham in Yamanashi / A Haunted Spot and Incident of Possession
Episodes.Description: The dry-cured ham that Haruno was looking forward to enjoying ended up being used as one of the recipe's ingredients! With a little convincing from Kako, the group heads out to buy some famous Yatsugatake ham instead. While on the road, they drop by abandoned places and ski areas here and there, enjoying some Kiyosato curry and visiting a variety of stores that sell ham.

Episodes.Title: Taking the Perfect Picture of a Maruishi Dosojin in Yamanashi! / We'll Enjoy Some Curry in Yamanashi
Episodes.Description: As a story idea for Haruno's manga, the girls participate in a "maruishi" hunting event in the prefecture.

Episodes.Title: First Time for an Anime Adaptation / Calling All Manga Artists! Minobu Walker
Episodes.Description: One of Haruno's manga artist friends, Isuzu, gets her work selected to be adapted into an anime! Worried about the money involved and how busy she'll be, she confides in Kurokuma and Haruno about how uneasy she feels about everything. The girls worry for Isuzu and, as a change of pace, participate in the Minobu Donburi Walk together.

Episodes.Title: Nagano/Toyama Trip That's on the Test (The First Night)
Episodes.Description: Haruno and the Cinephoto Club head to Nagano for a two-night-three-day trip for a scoop. While everyone raises their hand to suggest places they want to go to, An says she wants to film some skateboarding downhill with an action camera. To do this, though, they'll need someone to ride the skateboard with her....

Episodes.Title: Nagano/Toyama Trip That's on the Test (The Second Night)
Episodes.Description: The girls meet up and head over to Kurobe Dam, where they watch a documentary about the dam's construction.

Episodes.Title: Nagano/Toyama Trip That's on the Test (The Third Night)
Episodes.Description: It's the last day, and the group has gone all over Nagano to get this scoop. The group arrives at Togakushi, Nagano, where they try making fresh soba. They break into two teams: adults and children, and have a competition to make some soba! And finally, the group makes their last stop at a Ninja Trick Mansion, but what exactly awaits them there?

Episodes.Title: Enjoying All the Spots on the Yamanashi Shaved Ice Map
Episodes.Description: There are only two days left of summer vacation. As Cinephoto Club reflects upon this past summer, they realize they haven't eaten shaved ice yet! To make this the best summer vacation without any regrets, the group takes one last trip to enjoy all the shaved ice spots listed on the Yamanashi Shaved Iced Map.

Episodes.Description: The Cinephoto Club begins shooting a horror film, though not everything is as it seems.

Episodes.Description: Can Shirota make it to the end of Cinderella without messing up? Near the end, something unexpected happens!

Entries.Title: Hell Teacher: Jigoku Sensei Nube
Entries.Description: The town of Domori may be plagued by mysterious phenomena, but things are not going well for Class 5-3's new homeroom teacher Meisuke Nueno, either. Right from the start, Nueno, or "Nube" for short, becomes the target of fifth-grader Hiroshi's bursts of rage. After witnessing something bizarre, Nueno suspects there may be an otherworldly reason behind Hiroshi's sudden personality change.

Episodes.Title: The 99-Legged Bug
Episodes.Description: The town of Domori may be plagued by mysterious phenomena, but things are not going well for Class 5-3's new homeroom teacher Meisuke Nueno, either. Right from the start, Nueno, or "Nube" for short, becomes the target of fifth-grader Hiroshi's bursts of rage. After witnessing something bizarre, Nueno suspects there may be an otherworldly reason behind Hiroshi's sudden personality change.

Episodes.Title: Rampage of the Fox Demon
Episodes.Description: Nueno uses his ultimate weapon Demon Hand to exorcise the Yokai possessing Hiroshi. But suddenly, the mysterious and handsome Tamamo appears, kidnapping Hiroshi right before Nueno's eyes! As Nueno gives chase, Tamamo makes preparations throughout town for an unknown ritual. Just why did he kidnap Hiroshi, and what is his true identity?

Episodes.Title: The Midnight Honor Student
Episodes.Description: An unsettling shadow appears in the school in the dead of night. It's rumored that an honor student is erasing blackboards, replacing flowers of flower vases, and cleaning the rabbit cages when there should be no one there. To get to the truth of the matter, Hiroshi and his friends sneak into the school, only to encounter a voice in the dark saying, "Let's be friends!"

Episodes.Title: The Rokurokubi
Episodes.Description: After witnessing Nueno's amazing power, Miki becomes obsessed with gaining psychic abilities. She even tries to train while sleeping. When her efforts produce an unusual result, she joyfully celebrates her success. However, her friends are far from impressed. In fact, they are scared of what Miki has become.

Episodes.Title: Hatamonba's Curse
Episodes.Description: Katsuya will do anything to make his sister Manami happy, even if it means he has to run around borrowing money. That is how he unwittingly falls victim to the evil spirit Hatamonba's trap. When he realizes Hatemonba's deadly blade is not only pointing at his own neck, but also his sister's, he runs to Nueno for help. However, Hatamonba's sword appears to be mightier than Nueno's Demon Hand.

Episodes.Title: The Teketeke Ghost
Episodes.Description: Fear grips Makoto after he hears about Teketeke, the spirit of a girl who lost her lower body in a railway accident. According to the story, now she wanders the world in search of new legs. Makoto grows desperate for help upon learning that the spirit is coming for him within three days. However, Nueno urges him to forget everything, insisting that Teketeke is nothing more than a myth.

Episodes.Title: The Unseasonable Yuki-onna
Episodes.Description: As unseasonable snow blankets the town of Domori, a beautiful young woman appears before Nueno. Her name is Yukime, and she has come to fulfill a promise she made to him five years ago. Excited by their teacher's improbable romance, Nueno's students sneakily tag along on their date, only to witness Yukime's frosty intentions.

Episodes.Title: Great Inventions and Spirit World Communicators
Episodes.Description: Young inventor Akira finds a broken tablet and becomes even more obsessed with building great machines, as if he is possessed by something. One day, Akira announces he can bring the dead back to life, scaring his friends. Nueno senses something is wrong and investigates Akira's inventions, when he notices something strange within Akira's tablet...

Episodes.Title: The Girl Who Brings Happiness
Episodes.Description: One day, Nube meets a little girl in town. She is a Zashiki Warashi, a spirit that brings good fortune to people. The Zashiki Warashi becomes attached to Nube and follows him to school. From that day on, unexpected good fortune begins to befall his classmates one after another. However, as he sees how the students in his class gradually forget about hard work and start relying on good fortune, Nube finds it difficult to say goodbye to the Zashiki Warashi, but...

Episodes.Description: The club trip begins! After the train and sightseeing, they plan to use the outdoor oven. But then, it rains!

Episodes.Description: The club decides to have a food stall at the university fair, which means Nana will have to help customers!

Episodes.Description: The club takes a trip to Mako and Shinon's hometown. Mako is nervous about meeting her old friends again.

Episodes.Title: Are You Free for Christmas?

Episodes.Title: Thanks for the Feast!
Episodes.Description: The club gathers to give their clubroom a New Year's cleaning. They reminisce and enter the new year together!

Entries.Title: Spy High
Entries.Description: High school sophomore Blake Robbins' entire life changes when he's called into the principal's office and accused of selling drugs. The evidence is a photo of Blake taken in his bedroom. Blake's family files a lawsuit against the school district, causing a media frenzy, triggering an FBI investigation, and exposing shocking new evidence that sends his small suburban township into a furor.

Episodes.Title: Caught in the Act
Episodes.Description: High school sophomore Blake Robbins' entire life changes when he's called into the principal's office and accused of selling drugs. The evidence is a photo of Blake taken in his bedroom. Blake's family files a lawsuit against the school district, causing a media frenzy, triggering an FBI investigation, and exposing shocking new evidence that sends his small suburban township into a furor.

Episodes.Title: Project Green Light
Episodes.Description: The Lower Merion School District hires a prominent law firm to conduct an investigation into the spying allegations. The investigation reveals a startling discovery: over 56,000 images were captured from students' laptop webcams and dozens of students were recorded in their homes. The Robbins' attorney digs further, uncovering disturbing revelations from behind the scenes.

Episodes.Title: Not For Us
Episodes.Description: As the FBI investigate allegations that the Lower Merion School District spied on Blake Robbins, students Keron Williams and Jalil Hassan are notified that photos were taken of them with their laptop webcams. This discovery leads to an exploration of the complicated history of racial inequity in the school district. As the family and community prepare for trial, new obstacles arise.

Episodes.Title: Canary in the Coal Mine
Episodes.Description: When a settlement is reached, uncomfortable truths emerge about the winners and losers of the lawsuit. As the community moves on, the lasting impact on the victims and their families remains, while, today, student activity monitoring software is more prevalent than ever, leading to a host of troubling new consequences that raise the question: are we protecting children or harming them?

Episodes.Description: In the depths of the Lab, Shin and Heisuke join forces to take down the invisible assailant, while Sakamoto engages in an intense battle against Kashima.

Episodes.Title: Slice Slice Dance
Episodes.Description: While X and Gaku invade the JAA, a lone ORDER assassin stands in their way. Amid the chaos, Sakamoto discovers the shocking truth about X's identity.

Episodes.Title: Episode 1

Episodes.Title: Episode 8

Episodes.Title: Episode 11
